date.description: Date of the rejected update, when the provider echoes it back.

value.description: Rejected value, when the provider echoes it back.

error_code.description: Machine-readable failure reason, for example "validation" or "missing_field".

failed.description: Updates the provider rejected; inspect this even when the request returns HTTP 200.

ActionOutput_exist_updateattributevalues.description: Outcome of the batch, split into accepted and rejected updates.

syncs.description: Sync the full value history for every currently-owned (active) Exist attribute.
syncs.name: attribute-values

id.description: Unique record id built as "<attribute>:<date>", e.g. "steps:2026-10-07".

attribute.description: Name of the currently-owned Exist attribute this value belongs to, e.g. "steps".

date.description: Calendar date the value applies to, in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-10-07".

value.description: Value recorded for the date: number for Integer/Float/scale/period attributes, string for text attributes, 1/0 for boolean tags, or null when no value was recorded.

AttributeValue.description: A single daily value for one currently-owned Exist attribute.

syncs.description: Sync the user's attribute metadata (templated and custom, active and inactive), without values.
syncs.name: attributes

id.description: Stable identifier of the attribute; equal to its name.

name.description: Machine name of the attribute, e.g. "steps".

label.description: Human-readable label of the attribute, e.g. "Steps".

template.description: Name of the attribute template this attribute was created from; absent for a custom attribute.

group.description: Group the attribute belongs to, when the API reports one.

name.description: Machine name of the attribute group, e.g. "activity".

label.description: Human-readable label of the attribute group, e.g. "Activity".

priority.description: Display priority of the group; lower values are shown first.

service.description: Connected service currently supplying data; absent when the attribute is inactive or unowned.

name.description: Machine name of the connected service, e.g. "googlefit".

label.description: Human-readable label of the connected service, e.g. "Google Fit".

active.description: Whether the attribute is currently active; released attributes remain visible here as inactive.

priority.description: Display priority of the attribute; lower values are shown first.

manual.description: Whether the attribute is tracked manually rather than synced from a connected service.

value_type.description: Numeric enum of the stored value type: 0 Integer, 1 Float, 2 String, 3 Period (min), 4 Time of day (min from midnight), 5 Percentage, 6 Time of day (min from midday), 7 Boolean, 8 Integer scale (1-9).

available_services.description: Connected services that can provide data for this attribute.

name.description: Machine name of the connected service, e.g. "googlefit".

label.description: Human-readable label of the connected service, e.g. "Google Fit".

items.description: A connected service that can provide data for an attribute.

Attribute.description: An attribute definition tracked by the user, templated or custom, active or inactive.

syncs.description: Sync weekly average values per attribute.
syncs.name: averages

id.description: Composite identifier for the weekly average, formatted as `{attribute}_{date}`.

attribute.description: Name of the tracked attribute the average belongs to, e.g. "steps".

date.description: Week-identifying date in YYYY-MM-DD format that this set of averages covers.

overall.description: Average (median) value across the whole week.

monday.description: Average value for Monday of the week.

tuesday.description: Average value for Tuesday of the week.

wednesday.description: Average value for Wednesday of the week.

thursday.description: Average value for Thursday of the week.

friday.description: Average value for Friday of the week.

saturday.description: Average value for Saturday of the week.

sunday.description: Average value for Sunday of the week.

Average.description: A weekly average (median) snapshot for a single tracked attribute.

syncs.description: Sync the personalized insights Exist has generated for the user.
syncs.name: insights

id.description: Stable identifier derived from the insight type, target date, and creation timestamp.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when Exist generated the insight.

target_date.description: Local date (YYYY-MM-DD) the insight refers to, omitted when the insight covers a longer period or targets no specific day.

name.description: Machine-readable insight type name, e.g. "dow_sleep".

period.description: Number of days covered by the insight.

priority.description: Insight priority: 1 = real-time, 2 = day, 3 = week, 4 = month.

attribute.description: Attribute the insight was generated for, when the insight targets a specific attribute rather than a general summary.

name.description: Machine-readable attribute name, e.g. "sleep".
Machine-readable name of the attribute group, e.g. "sleep".

label.description: Human-readable label of the attribute group, e.g. "Sleep".

priority.description: Sort priority of the attribute group in ascending order.
Sort priority of the attribute in ascending order.

value_type.description: Numeric code for the attribute value type, e.g. 3 for a duration in minutes.

value_type_description.description: Human-readable description of the attribute value type, e.g. "Period (min)".

Insight.description: A personalized insight generated by Exist for the user.
